Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call: 

Recap: 
- Use case: Skylight wants to add multi-turn LLM summarization + classification inside the processing pipeline for user notes (low-latency, production traffic).
- Target: pilot -> 3mo ramp -> production. Expected pilot volume: TBD; ballpark discussed on call.
- Technical notes: preference for hosted API for pilot, Dedicated/Reserved for production if predictable throughput is needed. Dev has follow-ups around tokenization and avg response size.

Pricing/volume asks we discussed (action items): 
1) Can you confirm the budget owner and economic buyer for pricing/commit (name + email)?
2) Rough monthly token volumes (avg and peak) to size the right quote (e.g., avg X tokens/month, peak X).
3) Any target $/1M tokens or budget range you’re aiming for (helpful for options we show)?

Next steps (proposed):
- I’ll send a short pricing range for hosted + committed (Dedicated) options and explain unit economics that change the per-1M rate.
- Once you confirm budget owner, we’ll prepare a formal quote and SOC2 link for procurement.
- Dev (cc’d) will follow up on technical tokenization questions.

Attached: short pricing preview + call notes.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation on budget owner and volumes.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Skylight x Redwood - post-call recap & budget owner confirmation

Alex/Priya —

Appreciate the clarity — this is helpful. Below is a pragmatic pricing summary and some notes on what drives the per-1M token unit economics. Happy to refine once we have a confirmed token profile (avg response length, prompt+response breakdown).

High level pricing (illustrative ranges) — Hosted API (no long-term commitment):
- Base models / standard inference: $250–$350 per 1M tokens
- Optimized/quantized smaller models or high-batch workloads: $150–$250 per 1M tokens (depends on accuracy requirements)

Committed / Dedicated (reserved capacity) — better unit economics with monthly/annual commit:
- With a 6–12 month reserved commitment and expected avg 300M+/month: $100–$200 per 1M tokens (model and quantization dependent)
- Dedicated reserved pool pricing includes a base monthly commitment for GPU capacity + a lower per-token compute charge. We can model a target blended $/1M token (e.g., $150 target) based on your mix of generation/classification and expected caching efficiency.

What changes unit economics (short list):
- Model family / size (Larger models cost more compute per token)
- Avg response length (short summaries vs long-form outputs)
- Prefix reuse / KV caching (saves compute on repeated context)
- Batching and concurrency (higher batch utilization lowers per-token wall time)
- Quantization options (q8/q4) and acceptable latency/accuracy tradeoffs

Suggested next steps: 
1) Confirm Priya as budget owner and that Sara (VP Product) is the economic buyer for sign-off.
2) We’ll prepare a formal quote with two options: (A) Hosted pilot (month-to-month) with an illustrative $/1M (we suggest using $200/1M as a midpoint for sizing the pilot), and (B) Dedicated reserved example (12-month commit) showing how the blended $150/1M could be reached.
3) Dev will follow up with tokenization questions to finalize the avg token-per-request assumption.

I’ve attached a short pricing worksheet (spreadsheet) and included links to our SOC2 and standard invoice terms so procurement can review. If Priya confirms, I’ll generate the official quote and loop our account executive and legal for standard T&Cs.

Links / attachments:
- Pricing worksheet: [Attachment: pricing-estimate-1M.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]
- SOC2: https://redwood.example.com/soc2
- Example quote/DocuSign flow: https://www.docusign.com/some-fake-link/quote-SKY-2026-014

Would you be available for a 20-min call tomorrow morning to walk through the two options?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
